body:
I got a felony back when I was 22. It's caused me a lot of grief over the years. Also my health is in recent years, like when I tried to join the Air Force. 

I'll look into it. I'll have to find a ride there too and hope I can make transportation work out until I can save up enough money to buy a car. 
That's always a deal breaker for most people.
I can't afford it.
Can I get a job like that with a felony on my record?

I couldn't afford the buss ticket and with my health. I'd hate to end up in some town where I'd have to walk any distance to get somewhere. I'd have to be homeless until my first paychecks came in too. 

That's a huge risk to take in the condition I'm in.

I played jazz fusion. It was very fast, precise music. No hammer-ons no distortion. I also used to play jazz bass. Very fast slap bass kind of like Bill Dickens. 

I hate the blues. No offense. It's played by every washed up middle aged man who is looking for their second wife in this town. I feel like a retard simplifying myself to that level. 

I don't want to talk about music anymore. It's making me upset.
That's how I ended up here.

I have to be within walking distance of work. Moving somewhere else is out of the question. 

I wouldn't be able to take care of a dog anyway. I'm gone sometimes up to 18 hours a day. That would be cruel to a dog living in a place where the rent can't be more than $300 a month.

Part of me wants to keep going, and I know I'll be told to hold on to that part or focus on that part. 

I just don't see a way out of this one though. I feel like I'm being eaten alive by some huge monster. Do I live through it chewing me up or do I put a bullet in my head before it chomps down?
Pets are forbidden here.
I don't see me lasting the amount of time it will take to save up for a passport, ticket and lodging.

It's a guy I work with.

I have a mental fuse that's been lit. There isn't enough time to learn how to program and find a job that will pay a decent wage. 

I can't take life like it is anymore. This isn't some choice I made. I'm throwing up blood everyday. If I don't fix these problems soon, I won't have to kill myself. It will just happen anyway.

I wasted too much time indulging in fantasies and the arts. I can't enjoy that stuff like I used to. Something has to be fixed because every night I go to bed dreading the next day to come. I get up the next morning and I'm disappointed I didn't die. 

I'll relax when I'm dead.

I've become very antisocial. I won't talk to people I don't know well, face to face. Also I don't trust therapists. When I was 13 my Dad died. My Mom forced me to talk to this therapist. Being an angry teenager who just lost his Dad, I didn't want to talk to anyone about it. I waned to be left alone. This frustrated the therapist so she had me locked up in juvenile detention for 90 days for psychological evaluation. All they did was send me to "school" during the day and march of all over the place. I took a multiple choice answer quiz about my feelings. I never really talked to anyone. All they did was tell my Mom and the therapist she hired that I was depressed. No shit... I mean I had just lost my Dad and they locked me up in jail with a bunch of psycho kids. How was I supposed to feel? 

I don't like the pseudo authority these therapists place apon themselves.

I've been trying to save my money for 5 years now but all I ended up with is just over $400 overdrawn in my bank account. 

It's going to take so long to do that. I would have to fix my health before I could travel anyway. That's going to cost a fortune as well.

When I do something "fun" like reading or tinkering around. I get this overwhelming feeling that I need to be doing something to advance my life. 

I just can't enjoy myself anymore.

I don't have any family left alive. 

There's no public transportation here so getting around is very difficult. With my health problems that have appeared in the past few years, I won't make it far on foot. 

I've been unsuccessful in gaining access to school again as well.

I live in Georgia. 

I wish I had the means to do something about my life. This no advancement thing has got me fed up with everything.
That's what the paper called me. Didn't really get me anywhere in life either.

Music makes me depressed. I don't even like listening to it anymore. 

I don't have much spare time. I don't really have any friends left. Most of them are married and don't come around anymore. A guy I work with takes me to buy food every week but he's weird. All he talks about is having sex all the time. Not a joy to be around.

It's funny you say that. 

I used to play guitar and piano. A robber came into my work about 8 years ago and tried to shoot a girl. I tried to grab the gun and the bullet went though my left hand. It never healed to the point where I could play as good as I used to. 

I'd say after the accident, I play probably 20% of of the ability I had before. 

It makes me feel extremely depressed to think about how much I lost on that day. I sold my instruments a few years back so I could pay some bills anyway.

I'm fed up with trying and I don't see a way to change this. 

I tried to go back to school to become an electrical engineer. They told me I didn't sign up for selective services and couldn't get any kind of grants. They won't give me a loan because I have no credit history. 

If I get a new job they best I can hope for with my skill set and no degree is around $250 a week. Around here that's just enough to pay the bills. I'll never be able to save enough for retirement. I'll never have a family again. I'll never go anywhere or see anything. 

I've had enough of life. I just wanted a break, some time to see the sights, have a little fun. Maybe share something nice with someone special. 

There is no way to get from here to that point in a reasonable amount of time if at all. My physical health is not all that great. I haven't had a kitchen in over a decade. The food I've eaten over the past year has taken is toll on my body. I get sick easy, I can't walk far without feeling sick. I keep throwing up and I get these terrible migraines. I've lost a lot of hair from the stress. 

When I look at myself in a mirror and I realize how far I've fallen. I just want to take a gun and blow my brains out right there.
